T4.9.message: The note opens with 'Why Lord of Kāśī?' / 'काशी के स्वामी क्यों?' and answers with the Kṛttivāseśvara story. That frames the story as the reason Śiva is called Kāśīpati. The cited excerpts (kurma-purana-1-30.md, 1.30.13, 16–18, 22) only set the elephant-demon story in Vārāṇasī and name the liṅga. Nothing in them says this is why He is Lord of Kāśī. Every story detail is supported, but this causal link has no excerpt behind it. A human should decide whether the question reads as fair framing.
T4.9.suggested_fix: Soften the opening so it doesn't claim a cause, e.g. 'One of Kāśī's stories about its Lord: …' / 'काशी के स्वामी की एक कथा: …'.
